item.title: Re-advertisement: People and Culture Manager, (P-4), TA (6 months), #138386, Kinshasa, Dem. Rep. of Congo-WCAR
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is responding to its 17th Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak, confirmed in May 2026 and affecting Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The situation remains complex and evolving, with transmission occurring in both community and health-care settings. Response efforts are led by national authorities in a context shaped by health system limitations, logistical constraints, insecurity, displacement, and diverse community perceptions influencing health-seeking behaviors.UNICEF supports the Government through a multi-sectoral approach, focusing on community engagement, surveillance, infection prevention, and the continuity of essential services for vulnerable populations.This context requires strong coordination, adaptability, and cultural sensitivity to support effective and equitable response efforts, particularly for children and at-risk communities.

item.title: Business Analyst (Partnerships Effectiveness, Knowledge & Learning), P-2, Temporary Position (364 days), PPR, Office of the Global Director, New York, #00139004
item.description: The purpose of this assignment is to provide dedicated coordination and analytical support to connected areas of work that strengthen PPR's partnerships effectiveness and its delivery of the 2026-2029 SP: UNISON adoption and partnership intelligence across PPR teams; functional skills and capability mapping — built from the outset as the evidence base for a knowledge-enabled learning architecture aligned with PFP's Academy model; coordination of PPR's participation in the Skills Academy as a cross-cone initiative, including the development of PPR trainings; learning and knowledge management; AI and digital transformation; and the Division's strategic change initiatives. The assignment is a direct contribution to the Stewardship function (building and nurturing public partnership capacities and networks) and, through its UNISON adoption and partnership intelligence work, to the Insight function.

item.title: Chief of Communication, P-5, FT, #00089802, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo - WCAR
item.description: The Chief of Communication will be accountable for developing, managing, co-ordinating, networking, implementing and monitoring an advocacy and communication strategy and associated products and activities on a regular and on-going basis with public audiences, with the objective of promoting awareness, understanding, support and respect for children’s and women’s rights, and support for UNICEF's mission, priorities and programmes in the country office and at a global level and those of the UN Country Team.

item.title: Special Call for Person Living with Disability: Internship, Youth & Disability Inclusion with UNICEF Indonesia - only for Indonesians LIVING WITH DISABILITY
item.description: UNICEF Indonesia is opening an internship opportunity for persons living with disability (Indonesians only) to identify motivated and qualified young people who are interested in gaining practical experience with UNICEF and contributing their knowledge, skills and perspectives to UNICEF's work in Indonesia. The duration will be for 4-6 months, working with multiple sections: Health, Nutrition, Education, Planning, Monitoring Evaluation (PME), Private Fundraising and Partnerships (PFP), Communications, Operations and other programme or functional areas, depending on organizational needs.

item.title: Chief Field Office, P-4, FT, #099121, Bunia -Democratic Republic of Congo, WCAR
item.description: UNICEF is seeking an experienced humanitarian leader to head its Field Office in Bunia, Ituri Province. Children there face the combined effects of armed conflict, large-scale displacement, recurrent disease outbreaks and disrupted essential services.This position offers an opportunity for professionals who aspire to senior field leadership. It suits people who bring sound judgement, a collaborative management style and a strong commitment to staff well-being and principled humanitarian action.UNICEF is committed to diversity and inclusion within its workforce. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic background, including persons living with disabilities. Qualified female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

item.title: Senior Adviser WASH (Sanitation) (P-5), Fixed Term, #00133992, Global Programme Division, WASH, Nairobi - Kenya.
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Global WASH Practice and help accelerate access to safely managed, climate-resilient sanitation services for children and communities worldwide. Based in Nairobi, you will provide strategic leadership and technical assistance to governments and UNICEF Country Offices, driving sanitation system strengthening, sector financing, policy reform, innovation, and equitable service delivery. You will lead global efforts across sanitation, WASH in Schools, and Menstrual Health and Hygiene, while supporting climate resilience, governance reforms, digital solutions, and resource mobilization. Working with partners across development and humanitarian settings, you will help shape policies, strengthen institutions, mobilize investments, and scale sustainable solutions that improve outcomes for the most vulnerable children and families. This is a unique opportunity to influence global WASH priorities and contribute to UNICEF’s mission of leaving no child behind

item.title: Programme Specialist, (Polio) P-4, Fixed Term Position Peshawar, Pakistan, #00111987
item.description: UNICEF Pakistan is seeking an experienced program specialist/polio team lead to provide strategic leadership and technical oversight of the polio eradication program in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Based in Peshawar, the incumbent will lead program planning, implementation, monitoring, partnerships, and capacity-building efforts to deliver sustainable results for children.

item.title: Information Management Specialist (PRIMED) (P-3), TA, 364 days, #137062, East Jerusalem - State of Palestine, MENA
item.description: Join UNICEF and play a key role in strengthening humanitarian response through data-driven decision making. Ideal candidates will bring strong experience in information management, data analysis, humanitarian monitoring, and business intelligence platforms, with the ability to turn complex data into actionable insights that drive impact.

item.title: Supply Chain Specialist (Systems Strengthening), P-3, Fixed Term Position, Kabul, Afghanistan, #00138044
item.description: The ability of the Supply Chain Specialist to successfully plan, manage and oversee the effective and efficient supply chain management of goods, services and construction works for UNICEF programmes, and provide ongoing support to localization and end-user initiatives, directly impact on program goals and results for children. The impact of work directly affects the overall reputation of UNICEF with the authorities and the health donors. This in turn contributes to maintaining/enhancing the credibility of UNICEF as an effective and responsible manager of funds entrusted to the organization and to furthering UNICEF image as a competent organization for delivering cost effective and sustainable program results for children.

item.title: Technical Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark #00138905
item.description: Support cold chain and immunization supply chain initiatives through technical knowledge management, product quality improvement, infrastructure and energy solutions, and coordination of technical support to Country Offices.

item.title: Digital Impact Officer (Technology for Development), P-2, FT, #00018757, Digital Impact Division, Digital Empowerment – DCOE, Nairobi, Kenya.
item.description: This position supports UNICEF's digital transformation agenda by strengthening country-level access to digital, data, and AI solutions through the TeamOne collaboration model. The incumbent will help coordinate and facilitate cross-country support, contribute to the implementation and quality assurance of digital solutions using the UNICEF Digital Playbook, and ensure alignment with digital standards, cybersecurity, data protection, interoperability, and governance requirements. The role also supports the identification and triaging of country office digital, data, and AI needs, leveraging data and insights to improve support mechanisms and community engagement. In addition, the incumbent will contribute to knowledge management, learning, and capacity-building initiatives, foster knowledge sharing across UNICEF's digital community, and help strengthen digital capabilities across country offices through collaboration, learning events, and community management activities. This position is ideal for candidates with an interest in digital development, knowledge management, AI and data-driven innovation, stakeholder coordination, and digital capacity building in an international development context.

item.title: Health Specialist - Adolescent Health, P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00133499, Global Programme Division, Health-MNCAH, Nairobi - Kenya COE.
item.description: Join UNICEF's Global Programme Division as a Health Specialist (Adolescent Health) and play a pivotal role in advancing adolescent health and well-being worldwide. Based in Nairobi within UNICEF's Centre of Excellence, you will provide strategic leadership and technical expertise to strengthen adolescent-responsive health systems and services, influence global policy and guidance, and support countries in designing and scaling evidence-based programmes. Working closely with governments, development partners, UNICEF Regional and Country Offices, you will drive innovation, capacity development, knowledge generation, partnerships, and resource mobilization to improve equitable access to quality health services for adolescents and contribute to sustainable results at global, regional and country levels.

item.title: Chief Field Office (P-4), FT, #82112, Hyderabad, India - APRO
item.description: UNICEF India is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to serve as Chief Field Office, Hyderabad, India overseeing UNICEF’s engagement across the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka. Reporting to the Chief Field Services, the incumbent will provide overall leadership and management of the field office, driving programme excellence, policy advocacy, systems strengthening and partnerships to advance children's rights and development outcomes.

item.title: Programme Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, Majuro, Republic of Marshall Islands, #00138682, 364 days
item.description: Join UNICEF as a Programme Specialist, P-3 in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI), and play a pivotal role in advancing children’s rights and development across the North Pacific. This exciting position offers the opportunity to lead and manage high-impact programmes, working closely with government counterparts, development partners, communities, and civil society organizations to deliver sustainable and result-driven solutions for children and families. Ideal for a dynamic professional with strong programme management, partnership-building, and policy engagement experience, the role provides a unique platform to influence development priorities, strengthen national capacities, and support evidence-based programming. As part of UNICEF’s Pacific Multi-Country Office, you will contribute to programme planning, implementation, monitoring, and advocacy efforts while gaining valuable experience in a culturally rich and diverse island context.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations, (P-5) Fixed Term #86195, Niamey, Niger, WCAR
item.description: An exciting and rewarding opportunity has arisen at the UNICEF Niger Country Office for a highly motivated and committed professional to serve as Deputy Representative, Operations at the P-5 level. The Deputy Representative Operations serve as a core member of the senior management team, acting as a strategic partner to the Representative and Deputy Representative Programme in ensuring the effective, efficient, and compliant management of country office. The role also strengthens internal controls, promotes a culture of accountability and service excellence, and enables evidence-based decision-making, thereby supporting the Representative in achieving organizational objectives and maximizing impact at country level. Further, the role provides leadership and oversight of the operations function – covering administration budget, finance, Digital Impact, supply chain, and risk management while aligning Operations management with Programme delivery focusing on programmatic priorities. By leading multiple cross-functional teams, the Deputy Representative Operations drives integrated planning, resource optimization, risk management and performance monitoring, ensuring that systems, processes and people are positioned to deliver results.

item.title: Programme Specialist (Financing for Scale), P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00133668, Global Programme Division, Nutrition and Child Development, Brussels, Belgium
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Global Programme Division and help advance financing solutions that improve nutrition outcomes for children, adolescents, and women. As Programme Specialist (Financing for Scale), you will provide strategic leadership and technical expertise to strengthen nutrition financing through the Child Nutrition Fund (CNF), supporting governments and UNICEF Country Offices to identify, develop, and implement financing opportunities that increase investment in nutrition. You will build partnerships with multilateral development banks, international financial institutions, and other development finance actors, while advancing innovative and catalytic financing approaches. The role also leads evidence generation, knowledge development, advocacy, and thought leadership efforts to elevate nutrition financing on global, regional, and national agendas. Through these efforts, you will help mobilize resources, strengthen country-led investments, and expand the reach and impact of the CNF in support of improved outcomes for children.

item.title: Nutrition Specialist (P-3), FT, #00118343, Antananarivo, Madagascar, ESAR

Join a dynamic team committed to delivering lasting results for children and families across Madagascar.

item.title: Chief Emergency, P-5, FT, #138655, Caracas-Venezuela, LACR
item.description: The Venezuela Country Office operates in a complex and evolving humanitarian and development context in which children and families may be affected by multiple and overlapping risks, including natural hazards, public health emergencies, climate-related events, population movements and disruptions to essential social services. The major earthquake of June 2026 has added a significant humanitarian and recovery dimension, requiring UNICEF to sustain immediate humanitarian assistance while supporting the restoration and strengthening of essential services and national and local systems. At the same time, the Country Office must maintain readiness to respond to new or concurrent emergencies throughout the country.UNICEF Venezuela will therefore require a strong and integrated approach linking emergency preparedness, humanitarian response, early recovery and recovery, disaster risk reduction, anticipatory action and resilience.

item.title: Chief Education (P-4), Fixed Term Position, 24 months, #5192, Luanda - Angola

The role will lead programme strategy, partnerships and advocacy to improve equitable learning outcomes for children and adolescents across Angola.
